test_create_annotation: test creating an annotation via POST to /api/tasks/{task_id}/annotations/ and verifying task is marked labeled
test_create_annotation_with_ground_truth: test creating a ground truth annotation and verifying it does not trigger ML backend uploads
test_delete_annotation: test deleting an annotation via DELETE to /api/annotations/{id}/ and verifying task annotations count updates
test_accuracy: test task accuracy and is_labeled flag across multiple annotations from different annotator types
test_accuracy_on_delete: test task is_labeled flag recomputation after sequentially deleting annotations from distinct annotators
